decision: Lead event: Geminids peak (score 85), with Moon–Saturn on 17 Dec as the only secondary; skip everything else
rationale: The Geminids are the strongest event of the quarter: 150 ZHR, Moon only 21% and below the horizon, radiant 73° up in the south at 01:52. Moon–Saturn is a visible naked-eye pairing at 41° altitude in the evening. Venuss morning elongation is a weak 20° altitude and would dilute a 45 s script; Ursids/First Quarter are not worth a slot.
alternatives: Two-event short without the Geminids (rejected: misses the quarter's peak)
Add Venus as a third event (rejected: length and altitude)
